candidats.description: On 30 January 2018 a section of fencing had collapsed and the adjacent building site was even less secure than usual. New dumping there included a mattress - which may have contributed to the fence collapsing. I'd phoned a member of Haringey Council before Christmas 2017 and subsequently, reporting what seemed to me the worsening condition of the building site. Other rubbish visible through the gap in the fence included a pile of broken grey corrugated roofing tiles. I worried in case they contained asbestos. candidats.description: 23 February 2018. Looking east along Chesnut Road N17 near the corner of Rycroft Way. Until recently the site behind the propped-up facade had suffered from grossly inadequate gating. Probably as a result, for months it had piles of dumped rubbish, of rubble, and broken pieces of corrugated grey roofing. There was a full skip of rubbish. Plus assorted other trash. And graffiti, of course. Recent improvements followed after Martin Ball and I complained to Haringey Council. So credit and thanks for those arranging the clean-up.
